body.name: kink-residual proof handle
body.construction: Restrict the piecewise-Gaussian solution to \(h_{1,N}\) on \(E_{1,N}\), split Taylor's integral remainder according to whether a lattice jump crosses \(\gamma_N\), and combine the exact product ratio \(\rho_{1,N}(k+1)/\rho_{1,N}(k)\) with compact-uniform polynomial tails.
